notes: Human labels for methodology accuracy. Incomplete-memory items deliberately avoid Goa/café prompt examples (edge §9).
multi_label_counting_rule: An item may carry multiple taxonomy node ids. Category frequency is the count of distinct retrieval_related items labeled with that node (an item can increment more than one category). Ambiguous relevance items are excluded from headline frequency until a human accepts them.

items.text: I know we photographed the lakeside cabin with my cousin but I cannot remember which summer it was, and library search never brings those pictures up.
Trying to find the night market food stall photos from our trip. I remember the stall and the city walk, just not the date, and search is useless.
Need the photo of the warranty card I snapped sometime last autumn. Search by 'warranty' does nothing.
Nothing to do with finding old memories. Backup never finished after I switched phones and storage quota is full.
The photos are in trash and a locked folder. I am not forgetting the date — they were deleted.
I searched the exact date 12 March 2019 with the right album name and Google Photos still returned nothing, even though I can scroll to the photo.
Search failed so I opened years view and found the photo on my partner's phone instead. That workaround actually worked.
I tried search two or three times, then gave up. I do not know what kind of problem it was.
I cannot find last year's screenshots no matter what I type, and backup also keeps failing after I deleted some albums.
All the dates on my photos are wrong so I cannot find anything by when it happened. People tags are missing too.
I have thousands of photos, more than 3000, and old pictures from years ago are impossible to browse.
Search is fine for me. The problem is upload and sync, not finding photos I already have.
